claim: Opening §: 'The split is the lesson' — essential settings make the sound that sound, taste settings are what a player moves; a learner who can say which knobs are which has understood the patch.

pieces.what: house bass from the reference voice, then move a taste knob (cutoff) and an essential one (filter-envelope sustain): one stays house bass, the other stops being it; tests the split by ear
pieces.walks_up_from: the house bass as rendered, untouched

pieces.what: the house-bass card's signal-flow sheet in the house style
